scopeNotes: The harness disabled Wi-Fi and mobile data and waited for no active default route before the two CORE methods; it enabled connectivity only for the explicitly selected optional-data stage.

Actual MediaPipe HandLandmarker processed a synthetic blank bitmap with the included pinned model. This does not demonstrate recognizing real hands, cursor precision, clicking or scrolling in another application.

The optional-data test downloaded pinned model data through real HTTPS, checked size/SHA-256, reused private files, executed native classification/OCR, blocked deletion during an active lease and removed optional data while preserving the hand asset and synthetic user marker.

The resume fixture uses a 128 KiB prefix copied from an earlier fully verified real download. The test does not assert HTTP 206 or exercise a live user cancellation; a valid HTTP 200 restart is permitted.
No physical Samsung A03, real camera/microphone session, voice, continuous background operation, general multimodal image understanding or Google Play Protect approval was tested by this workflow.
These three instrumented methods are separate from the larger device-smoke suite. Their success does not imply that other CI suites passed.
